name: ANSI Highlighter Premium
description:
ANSI Highlighter Premium enables the fast rendering of ANSI control-code sequences in log files, regardless their size, from within the text editor of all IntelliJ Platform-based products. The following features are available.

Customizable ANSI colors:

  • Go to Settings | Editor | Colors Scheme | Console Colors
  • Expand 'ANSI Colors'
  • Customize foreground and background colors as needed
  • Press 'Apply'
  • Default foreground can be customized from Settings | Editor | Colors Scheme | Console Colors | Console | Standard Output | Foreground

Customizable 'ANSI Aware' file extensions:

  • Go to Settings | Editor | File Types
  • Under 'Recognized File Types' select 'ANSI Aware'
  • Under 'File name patterns' add your custom 'ANSI Aware' file extensions, *.log is added by default
  • Press 'Apply'

Double display mode:

Use any of the following options to switch between ANSI Highlighter vs Plain modes:

  • Click 'Show Plain Mode' from the banner on top of the editor
  • Switch between 'Plain' and 'ANSI Highlighter' tabs at the bottom
  • Right click on the editor and press 'Switch to Plain / ANSI Highlighter mode'
  • Alternatively place the caret on the editor and use the keyboard shortcut 'ctrl meta A' (customizable from Settings | Keymap | Plugins | ANSI Highlighter Premium)

Optional extended ANSI viewer:

  • Enable/disable under Settings | Editor | ANSI Highlighter | Use the extended ANSI viewer for smaller files
  • Activates 'Paste as ANSI' and line numbers gutter within the IDE file size limit
  • The status bar shows the displayed line/column and selection size, plus the source file's line endings, encoding, and indentation settings. Click the position to go to a line.
  • The fast restricted ANSI viewer continues to be used when extended viewer is disabled, or file size exceeds IDE file size limit.
  • Keep the option disabled for continuously growing logs: substantial growth can cause memory overflow / IDE errors.
  • Disabled by default: user should be aware of growing files risk before they optin

Copy/Paste as ANSI:

  • Select highlighted text in ANSI Highlighter mode and activate 'Copy as ANSI' from the context menu.
  • Use 'Paste as ANSI' to paste, save the target file and trigger ANSI code detection.
  • 'Paste as ANSI' under ANSI Highlight mode offers optional line breaks before and after the pasted text.
  • Shortcuts can be assigned under Settings | Keymap | Plugins | ANSI Highlighter Premium.
  • Copied fragment starts and ends with a reset.
  • ANSI Highlight mode restores trailing text styles after reset, plain mode doesn't.
  • 'Paste as ANSI' is available only within the IDE file size limit.
  • 'Paste as ANSI' is not available under ANSI Highlight mode when extended ANSI viewer is disabled.
  • Undo/Redo is supported under ANSI Highlight mode when extended ANSI viewer is enabled.
  • Normal Copy/Paste continues to copy/paste plain text.

Supported ANSI codes:

  • Reset code (0)
  • Bold code (1)
  • Dim / faint code (2)
  • Italic code (3)
  • Single Underline code (4)
  • All text foreground color codes (30-37)
  • All text high intensity foreground color codes (90-97)
  • All text background color codes (40-47)
  • All text high intensity background color codes (100-107)

Hyperlinks:

  • Clickable JVM stack trace locations
  • Clickable URL/URI links
  • Clickable absolute local file paths
  • Clickable file paths with line numbers when available

Soft Wrap:

  • Go to Settings | Editor | General | Console
  • Toggle 'Use soft wraps in console'
  • To force soft wrap when line length is too large go to Settings | Advanced Settings
  • Customize 'Force soft wrap in documents with lines larger than...'
